Abbreviation / Acronym: Description: HSM Hardware Software Module PKI Public Key Infrastructure SHE Secure Hardware Extension TPM Trusted Platform Module Table 3.1: Acronyms and Abbreviations 7 of 28 Document ID 889: AUTOSAR_AP_RS_Cryptography Requirements on Cryptography AUTOSAR AP R25-11 4 Requirements Specification 4.1 Functional Overview The AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform provides functionality to perform cryptographic op- erations by using standardized interfaces and associated modeling. 4.2 Functional Requirements [RS_CRYPTO_02001] The Crypto Stack shall conceal symmetric keys from the users Status: DRAFT Description: There shall be no interfaces for the users to directly extract symmetric key values. Keys shall be addressed via identifiers by the users, preventing the key values disclosure. Rationale: If symmetric key values are available in the application at runtime it increases the risk of key compromise. If symmetric key values are stored in the application, centralized key management (e.g. renewal) is hard. Dependencies: – Use Case: Keys are stored in HSMs and never exposed in plain text.
